about.title: Studio
about.lead: AURA360LAB is an architecture and visualization studio working between design and image — shaping buildings and interiors, then rendering them with the clarity of a photograph.
about.story: AURA360LAB began with a simple frustration: great architecture too often gets lost in translation between the drawing board and the people it is built for. We set out to close that gap by keeping design and visualization under one roof. Today we work with developers, private clients and fellow architects to take projects from first concept to fully rendered reality.
about.mission: To make architecture understandable and felt — turning complex ideas into spaces and images everyone in the room can read.
about.vision: A practice where design and visualization are never separate steps, but a single continuous craft.
about.philosophy: We design with restraint. Light, proportion and material do the talking; everything unnecessary is removed. The same discipline carries into our renders — honest, calm and precise.
about.teamIntro: A compact studio of architects, designers and visualization artists.
